notes: Mechanism study, not strength evaluation. Source cohort resets Adam/local counter; mature cohort loads unchanged1M final Adam and resets only its new-experiment local counter. Probe holds weights fixed across groups and uses a private deterministic grouping RNG; preserve model,Adam,global RNG and actual PPO update bitwise in integration tests. Keep all trajectories from one physical decision-bearing hand together via hand markers. Equal-hand groups use globally normalized transition weighting; report group row counts and excluded remainder hands. Inspect PPO-only and regularized-actor gradients separately,including each policy head.

Report between-group covariance trace,mean gradient squared norm,signal estimate minus group-variance/num_groups,cosine agreement,and noise-to-signal at observed group size. Nonpositive estimated signal is unresolved,not infinite certainty. Diagnostic admission to a bounded optimizer-batch treatment requires PPO noise-to-signal>1 or unresolved signal in >=75percent of observed updates in BOTH cohorts; otherwise do not infer small-batch noise as the primary mechanism. Finite batch/global advantage normalization and league dependence limit IID/critical-batch interpretations. No optimal batch size or poker gain is claimed by these probes.

result.summary: Completed40155 measured physical hands in two4-update cohorts. All8 PPO whole-hand probes meet the prespecified noise criterion; source/mature median noise-to-signal26.48/36.54. Both session audits and Gram recomputation PASS.
result.conclusion: Fixed-weight native actor gradients are noise dominated at approximately256 decision-bearing hands per group. The mature Adam state advanced6048to6162 without reset. This is pre-Adam,clustered descriptive evidence with global-advantage/league dependencies,not an optimal batch estimate or poker-strength result.

Profile memory before production,keep all other objectives/anchors fixed,record actual Adam steps/physical work,then frozen independent multi-anchor evaluation. Treat this as a joint batch/LR regimen,not a pure causal batch ablation; no paper-scale expansion without reproduced poker gains.
